findings.what: Reminder sweep endpoint exists but no scheduler is configured; reminders never fire out of the box
PRD-specified Schedule-X resource view replaced by custom table grid (documented deviation, OQ-006)
In-memory rate limiter keyed on spoofable x-forwarded-for; not shared across instances
Unauthenticated booking with an existing email overwrites that patient's stored name/phone
Overlap guard is READ COMMITTED and unique index is start_time-only; >15-min services or off-grid override walk-ins can overlap concurrently
No lower bound on reminder window; bookings made <24h ahead get an immediate 'reminder'
